The same guest can look like three different customers across three different systems. DashOS is DoorDash s platform for fixing that. It connects marketplace ordering, direct ordering, reservations, loyalty, guest management, marketing and point of sale around one shared view of the guest, so every product gets smarter as the others are used. DoorDash launched DashOS publicly at Dash Forward in September 2026, and from 2027 more than 80,000 restaurants on leading POS and middleware partners. DashOS Engineering brings together engineers from across DoorDash, Deliveroo and Wolt into one global organisation, led from London. Our teams cover reservations and guest CRM, digital ordering and omnichannel loyalty, POS and self-order kiosks, AI-powered marketing and Voice AI, and the shared data and integration platforms that connect them. Each team owns its own roadmap. The shared mission is making them work as one system. jobs.description: Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve. We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that. Here’s what this particular role covers. 🛠️ About our Engineering Teams Wayve’s Robot Software group turns new vehicle programs into stable, reliable robot systems. The Platform Integration team works at the boundary between onboard software and vehicle hardware, bringing up new platforms while building reusable components and frameworks that make every future integration faster and more predictable. As a Software Engineer on the Platform Integration team, you’ll combine hands-on vehicle and bench work with production software development. Your work will directly enable safe, scalable deployment across multiple vehicle programs. 🧠 Your day-to-day Support software bring-up on benches, HiL systems, and vehicles, including work at international test locations. Develop and maintain vehicle-facing software components and shared frameworks. Diagnose integration issues across software and hardware boundaries and drive them through resolution. Identify architectural improvements that reduce bespoke work and improve reuse. Build diagnostics, tooling, and metrics for robot-software reliability and performance. Unsere Graphen-Photonik-Innovation steigert die Rechenleistung und Effizienz in einer neuen Größenordnung. jobs.title: DevOps Engineer, Edge and Developer Experience (Remote Eligible in Bulgaria)
jobs.description: For over 20 years, Smartsheet has empowered teams to manage work seamlessly and scale solutions smarter. Now, in our most ambitious chapter yet, we are uniting human teams with AI agents. By orchestrating the work agents do best, automating manual tasks and uncovering insights at scale, we create the space for people to focus on what truly matters: judgment, creativity, and big thinking. That is magic at work, and it’s what we show up for every day. We are seeking a DevOps Engineer II to join the Edge and Developer Experience team. Our team collaboratively operates Smartsheet's high-performance edge proxy platform and drives the adoption of internal engineering tooling. The edge proxy serves as the entry point for all traffic across Smartsheet's commercial and FedRAMP-authorized US Government environments. The team supports the lifecycle of this platform: from maintaining proxy configurations, to provisioning the multi-region AWS EKS infrastructure it runs on, to assisting with observability. Beyond the edge layer, the team also drives the integration of internal developer tooling — from а developer portal (IDP) to standardized CI/CD pipelines — that improves the engineering experience and velocity across the company. You will work remotely from Bulgaria and report to one of our engineering leaders in Bulgaria. You will: Contribute to the edge proxy platform: Assist in maintaining, upgrading, and extending a high-performance reverse proxy. This includes writing Go and Python automation, managing container images on hardened Linux bases, and working with CDN and traffic management capabilities. Build and maintain cloud infrastructure as code: Implement Terraform/Terragrunt modules and live environment configurations for EKS clusters, load balancers, IAM roles, and supporting AWS services. jobs.title: Rekrutmen Contract Service Acceptance PT Patra Drilling Contractor (PDC)
jobs.description: PT Patra Drilling Contractor (PDC) adalah perusahaan yang bergerak pada bidang jasa penunjang dalam industri energi di Indonesia. Anak Perusahaan PT Pertamina Drilling Services Indonesia (Pertamina Drilling) yang merupakan bagian dari Subholding Upstream Pertamina. Lowongan Kerja PT Patra Drilling Contractor (PDC). PDC (selanjutnya disebut sebagai Perseroan) didirikan pada 11 September 1981 sebagai perusahaan nasional pertama yang fokus menyediakan layanan pengeboran lepas pantai di Indonesia sebagai prioritas pertama. Setelah 38 tahun berkontribusi dalam penyediaan energi nasional, Perseroan semakin memantapkan langkahnya menjadi perusahaan jasa penunjang industri energi terdepan yang mengutamakan keseimbangan antara aspek people dan , profit dan planet. Hal tersebut dibuktikan dengan pertumbuhan kinerja Perseroan secara eksponensial yang diiringi dengan penguatan pada aspek sosial dan lingkungan. Langkah nyata yang dilakukan Perseroan yaitu dengan memperkuat tata kelola keberlanjutan terutama di bidang kesehatan, keselamatan, keamanan dan pelestarian lingkungan serta mendorong pemerataan kesejahteraan sosial di masyarakat sekitar proyek. Laporan Keberlanjutan Tahun 2019 dikembangkan dengan tema: Mengutamakan Keberlanjutan sebagai Cara untuk Terus Bertumbuh. Lowongan Kerja PT Patra Drilling Contractor (PDC) Saat ini PT Patra Drilling Contractor (PDC) memberikan kesempatan lowongan kerja untuk dapat bergabung bersama dengan posisi sebagai berikut: Associate Contract Service Acceptance Uraian Tugas: Menyiapkan, mengumpulkan, dan memverifikasi dokumen administrasi, serta dokumen pendukung penagihan; Melakukan monitoring aging dan progress invoice, serta follow-up kepada customer; Melakukan koordinasi dan komunikasi dengan customer, user, vendor, dan stakeholder terkait; Memastikan kesesuaian invoice dengan realisasi pekerjaan dan dokumen pendukung; Menyusun dan melakukan monitoring estimasi nilai pekerjaan bulanan (accrual); Melakukan update dan monitoring data revenu

Als Senior Development Engineer Mechatronics gestaltest du an der Schnittstelle zwischen Entwicklung und Produktion fertigungsgerechte Produkte und leistungsfähige Produktionsprozesse – von der Begleitung neuer Produkte in der Entwicklung über die Einführung in die Serienproduktion bis zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung bestehender Fertigungsabläufe. Aufgaben Die Produktion von Neuprodukt-Entwicklungen planen und umsetzen, geeignete Montage- und Prüfprozesse entwickeln und die Fertigungsbereitschaft sicherstellen. Während der Produktentwicklung die Verantwortung für Design for Manufacturing und Design to Cost aus Fertigungssicht übernehmen und gemeinsam mit dem Entwicklungsbereich eine fertigungsgerechte und wirtschaftliche Produktgestaltung sicherstellen. Lean-Initiativen durch geeignete technische Lösungen unterstützen, Produktionsabläufe vereinfachen und Verschwendung reduzieren. Kontinuierliche Verbesserung: Bestehende Fertigungsprozesse und mechatronische Systeme hinsichtlich Qualität, Effizienz, Zuverlässigkeit und Bedienbarkeit weiterentwickeln. Fertigungsaufbauten und Prozesse dokumentieren sowie die Produktion bei Einführung und Anwendung schulen und unterstützen. Requirements Abgeschlossenes Masterstudium in Mechatronik, Elektrotechnik oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung. Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im Manufacturing Engineering, in der produktionsnahen Entwicklung oder einem vergleichbaren Umfeld. Fundierte Kenntnisse in Design for Manufacturing und Design to Cost und Erfahrung in deren Anwendung während der Produktentwicklung. Gutes Verständnis für das Zusammenspiel von Mechanik, Elektronik und Steuerungstechnik; Kenntnisse in der Optik sind von Vorteil. Eine strukturierte, selbstständige und praxisorientierte Arbeitsweise sowie Freude an der Zusammenarbeit mit Entwicklung und Produktion. Sehr gute Ko

jobs.title: Staff Application Security Engineer
jobs.description: Who we are Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale. Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term. About the role: Samsara sits at the center of hardware, software, AI, and the physical world, processing 25+ trillion data points annually across thousands of connected devices. The Samsara Application Security team protects this vast footprint end-to-end, spanning cloud services, internal systems, and firmware running on IoT hardware in the field. As a Staff Application Security Engineer, you'll drive the overarching technical direction for our application security and vulnerability management programs. This is a high-visibility role where you'll influence a broad surface area while retaining the flexibility to dive deep into critical domain focus areas as security priorities evolve. This is a remote position, open to candidates residing in the UK. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role. jobs.description: About Fractile Fractile was founded in 2022 on the bet that, eventually, the world’s most capable AI systems would be limited in their impact by the time taken to produce useful outputs. We bet everything on the logical conclusion: that the only way to truly unlock this latent value, to make speed viable at scale, was to radically re-invent the hardware that we run our frontier AI models on. Ever since, we have been building chips and systems that tackle this problem: how to efficiently generate output at thousands of tokens per second, while handling the complexity and capacity challenges of operating large models at very long contexts. The workloads that push to the limits of the current frontier are already transformational; it is the technical and economic limits on inference speed that are constraining progress. The defining work of the 21st century will be marked by the engine of inference delivering immense and diffuse chains of intellectual inquiry, in drug discovery, in software engineering, in materials discovery, in any field where progress is driven by deep reasoning and intelligence to resolve complex problems. Fractile is building the next generation of AI computing technology, developing innovative hardware and software solutions designed to transform the performance and efficiency of AI workloads. We're bringing together exceptional talent across semiconductor engineering, software, and AI to solve some of the most ambitious challenges in computing. jobs.title: Ingénieur Conception & Instrumentation - Équipements et bancs d’essais (H/F)
jobs.description: Ingénieur Conception & Instrumentation – Équipements et bancs d’essais (H/F) À propos de notre client Notre client est une TPE basée au nord de Lyon, spécialisée dans les énergies du sous-sol : pétrole, gaz, géothermie et stockage de CO2. Son activité repose entièrement sur la R&D : essais sur géomatériaux, géomécanique et développement d'équipements d'essais pour des clients internationaux. Son équipe pluridisciplinaire et multiculturelle développe des solutions technologiques innovantes au service de l'efficacité, de la protection de l'environnement et de la maîtrise des coûts. L'entreprise est certifiée ISO 9001 et toutes ses activités respectent sa démarche QHSE. Le poste Votre rôle : mettre au point de véritables méthodes d’essai. À partir d’un besoin de mesure (température, pression, déplacement, déformation, ultrasons…), vous concevez, instrumentez et validez des cellules d’essais haute température et haute pression. Vous commencez par fiabiliser une cellule existante : simplifier son montage et son démontage, puis la valider à plus haute température. Vous lancez ensuite les cellules suivantes. Vous travaillez avec l’équipe qui conçoit aujourd’hui les équipements, et avec le bureau d’études d’un fabricant partenaire qui réalise la conception détaillée et les plans de fabrication. Environ 70-80 % conception et développement, 20-30 % laboratoire. Rattachement à la direction des opérations. Ce que le poste n’est pas : ni dessinateur ou calculateur (le détail et les plans sont externalisés), ni management d’équipe. Vos missions Définir le besoin, le cahier des charges et le pré-dimensionnement fonctionnel de nouvelles cellules. Choisir les capteurs adaptés et les intégrer ; résoudre les enjeux d’étanchéité, de tenue en température et en pression. Consulter fournisseurs et sous-traitants, suivre la fabrication des pièces. Monter, instrumenter et tester vous-même vos équipements au laboratoire ; interpréter les mesures et améliorer. Améliorer l’ergonomie des équipe

Dann bist du bei uns richtig. Deeken Technology ist ein etabliertes IT-Systemhaus aus dem Oldenburger Münsterland - seit über 10 Jahren am Markt, mit einem motivierten und engagierten Team. Wir betreuen mittelständische Unternehmen ganzheitlich: IT-Infrastruktur, IT-Sicherheit, Digitalisierung und Telekommunikation. Dabei verkaufen wir keine Einmal-Lösungen, sondern sind langfristiger IT-Partner unserer Kunden - wir kennen ihre Systeme, ihre Abläufe und ihre Ansprechpartner. Für unser Team in unseren neuen Büros im ecopark Emstek suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt einen Systemadministrator (m/w/d) mit Schwerpunkt Microsoft - unbefristet, in Vollzeit mit 39 Stunden und hybrid. Deine Aufgaben Bei uns ist jeder Spezialist in seinem Fachgebiet - niemand muss alles können. Dein Schwerpunkt sind die Microsoft-Umgebungen unserer Kunden, vom Serverraum bis in die Cloud. - Du installierst, aktualisierst und betreust Domänencontroller sowie File- und Anwendungsserver - On-Premise und in Cloud-Umgebungen. - Du administrierst Microsoft 365, insbesondere Exchange Online, Entra ID und Intune. - Du richtest Clients ein und erstellst dafür die passenden Intune-Richtlinien und Bereitstellungspläne. - Du installierst Fachanwendungen unserer Kunden wie ERP- oder Dokumentenmanagement-Systeme, begleitest Updates und stimmst dich dabei mit den Softwareherstellern ab. - Du bindest Kundeninfrastrukturen in unser Monitoring ein - damit wir Probleme erkennen, bevor unsere Kunden sie bemerken. - Du arbeitest eng mit deinen Kollegen aus den anderen Fachbereichen zusammen, erklärst technische Zusammenhänge verständlich und dokumentierst sauber in unserer Service-Plattform Hindeo. Das bringst du mit Fachwissen ist wichtig - Haltung entscheidet. Zwei Dinge sind uns deshalb bei jeder Einstellung besonders wichtig: Du kommunizierst klar

jobs.title: Senior Product Designer - Move-in & Staying
jobs.description: We're on a mission to become the go-to destination for students across Europe to find a trusted home away from home. We make every step of the rental journey simple and seamless, so students can focus on what really matters: studying, exploring, and growing. With HousingAnywhere, Kamernet, and Studapart under our roof, we're Europe's largest student rental platform. You'll find us in Rotterdam, Paris, and Cergy, always guided by our four core values: Ownership, We are enablers, We are changemakers, and We are connectors. Your role Help people find their next home with absolute certainty. Moving to a new country is an adventure, but finding a home shouldn't be the hardest part. At HousingAnywhere, we're revolutionizing renting by building a platform that helps people confidently rent a home abroad. Design isn't here to polish screens. It's here to shape the product. We are looking for a Senior Product Designer to own the Listing & Finding experience. You will define what discovering a home feels like: fast, relevant, trustworthy, and human. As the design owner for one of the most important journeys in our marketplace, you will: Shape the long-term vision for the search and discovery experience. Lead projects from early discovery through launch and iteration. Use qualitative research, behavioural data, and experimentation to make decisions, not opinions. Define success, measure impact, and continuously improve your solutions. Raise the quality bar across the design team through thoughtful critique and craft. Contribute to our design principles, design system, and the way we build the product. Your team Collaborate deeply. Design with absolute purpose. You'll work alongside Product, Engineering, Research, and Data as an equal partner to challenge assumptions, validate ideas, and turn ambiguity into a product that genuinely improves people's lives. We move fast, we think ahead, and we focus on what our audience truly needs. You'll have the freedom to influence your team

jobs.description: Location : Paris, France (Hybrid)  We Are : RTB House is a next-generation performance demand-side platform (DSP) that uses proprietary Deep Learning AI algorithms to help brands grow. The company is the market leader in driving performance using Deep Learning across the entire purchase funnel. Founded in 2012 and now operating in 90+ markets, RTB House has always been private-by-design. It embraces first-party advertising and a relentless approach to innovation. Our team in France consists of 45 people (including 14 Technical Account Managers based either in France or Poland) and is an integral part of our company’s global presence. We combine local expertise with our broader company vision.  As a Technical Account Management Team Leader you will lead and coordinate a team responsible for technical support, oversee the launch and optimisation of RTB advertising campaigns and ensure effective collaboration with clients and internal stakeholders. jobs.description: About Andercore Andercore is the AI-native supplier of industrial materials and goods for energy and infrastructure. We execute trade and distribution end-to-end, on our own account, at the speed of compute - and we are becoming the supplier of record for the entire industry. Industrial procurement is a €900B market in Europe alone and the largest manual market on earth. 95% of customers have no direct access to global supply chains. Materials pass through four or five intermediaries before they reach a site, and 40% of the margin evaporates on the way. For decades, the operating system of this industry was people: people to source, negotiate, finance, ship, and sell. We built the alternative from scratch. We are the supplier. We buy from global sources and sell to European customers on our own account. Our AI runs the full trade: sourcing, quality, pricing, sales, logistics, credit, and financing. One request. A firm quote in minutes. Delivered on time. For the customer, it feels like buying from their preferred local supplier. No warehouses. No fleet. No inventory risk. Every trade is pre-sold before it is bought. We are also the credit counterparty. Customers are scored and insured in minutes and get up to 60 days of payment terms priced into the quote itself. The working capital behind every trade is bank-funded, not equity-funded. STAF ADMINISTRASI BEYOND KWH DI PLN NUSA DAYA Persyaratan Umum : Pria/Wanita Mampu mengoperasikan Microsoft Office, khususnya Microsoft Excel. Memiliki kemampuan administrasi, pengolahan data, dan pengelolaan dokumen yang baik. Teliti, disiplin, jujur, dan bertanggung jawab. Memiliki kemampuan komunikasi dan koordinasi yang baik serta mampu bekerja secara individu maupun tim. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes  and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast. jobs.title: Technisch Support Engineer
jobs.description: Bij DeWarmte maken we slimme en betaalbare warmtepompen waarmee we woningen van het gas af helpen. We ontwerpen onze producten zelf, assembleren ze in Utrecht en zorgen samen met onze installatiepartners dat ze bij steeds meer mensen thuis komen te staan. Steeds meer woningen worden verwarmd met onze warmtepompen. En dat betekent dat we ook steeds meer installaties moeten monitoren, klanten ondersteunen en technische problemen oplossen. Daarom zoeken we een Technical Support Engineer die ons support team komt versterken. Je helpt klanten en monteurs bij technische vragen, onderzoekt storingen en zorgt dat onze warmtepompen optimaal blijven functioneren. Tegelijkertijd kijk je verder dan het probleem van vandaag. jobs.title: Data Scientist (Measurement & Signal Processing) (f/m/d)
jobs.description: Description QuantumDiamonds is a novel equipment vendor from Germany which builds magnetic field imaging systems based on quantum sensors. Our Data Science & Machine Learning team in Pre-Development owns the chain from raw quantum sensor data to the current map an engineer can act on: the statistical evaluation of the sensor signal, the simulation and training data pipelines, the reconstruction of fields and currents, with the machine learning pipeline for three-dimensional current in production today, and the validation of every map against simulation and reference measurements. We are looking for a Data Scientist to own one question for the team: can we trust this map, and if not, where in the chain did it go wrong? Every measurement, in our lab or at a customer, gets a verdict and a reason. You build the checks that produce it, keep the catalogue of known artifacts and reference measurements behind it, and make it automatic for the routine cases so that your judgement goes to the hard ones. When a check fails, you trace it to its source in the chain, fix it when it sits in the evaluation, and drive the fix with the owning engineer when it does not. Our Applications engineers, who run the customer projects, rely on your verdict for what reaches the customer. A senior data scientist on the team backs you on the hard calls at the start; the aim is that you become the owner of this question. This is a hands-on analysis role, not a research position: the data is real, the chain is in daily use, and every improvement you make shows up in the next measurement. Your background does not need to be in quantum sensing or semiconductors: if you have learned to tell signal from noise, calibration errors and artifacts in another demanding measurement system, we want to hear from you. jobs.title: Quantum Sensing Engineer (NV Centers) (f/m/d)
jobs.description: Description QuantumDiamonds is building commercial quantum sensing tools for semiconductor inspection and failure analysis. As our Quantum Sensing Engineer (NV Centers) , you will join the Hardware Pre-Development Team and take technical ownership of the sensing core of our widefield Quantum Diamond Microscope (QDM). At the heart of your role is one question: how do we get more performance out of the NV sensing system? You will work across the complete sensing chain — from the diamond sensor and laser excitation through microwave spin control and bias magnetics to fluorescence collection and camera readout. When sensitivity, resolution, speed, or stability falls short, you will investigate the system end to end, identify the limiting mechanism, and turn your findings into measurable improvements. The diamond sensor itself is an important part of that challenge. Together with internal experts and external partners, you will help drive the development of our NV diamond material — connecting epitaxy, irradiation, annealing, surface preparation, and optical coatings to the performance we ultimately achieve at the system level. This is a hands-on R&D role spanning quantum physics, experimental hardware, and sensor development. You will take ideas from first principles through experiments and prototypes to validated technologies that can be transferred into our products. At Summit, we believe in building a team of world class professionals who are passionate about this mission, and it is our people who drive this mission to reality. Summit’s core values include integrity, passion for excellence, purposeful urgency, collaboration, and our commitment to people. Summit’s team is inspired to touch and help change lives through Summit’s clinical studies in the field of oncology. Summit has multiple global Phase 3 clinical studies, including: Non-small Cell Lung Cancer (NSCLC) HARMONi: Phase 3 clinical study which was intended to evaluate ivonescimab combined with chemotherapy compared to placebo plus chemotherapy in patients with EGFR-mutated, locally advanced or metastatic non-squamous NSCLC who were previously treated with a 3rd generation EGFR TKI. HARMONi-3: Phase 3 clinical study which is intended to evaluate ivonescimab combined with chemotherapy compared to pembrolizumab combined with chemotherapy in patients with first-line metastatic NSCLC. Ivonescimab is an investigational therapy not presently approved by any regulatory authority other than China’s National Medical Products Administration (NMPA). jobs.title: Lead Software Engineer
jobs.description: Building the intelligence behind Solskin Are you a driven person who wants to make buildings come alive? We are Zurich Soft Robotics (ZSR), a Zurich-based startup developing Solskin – a climate-adaptive solar facade. Solskin is not just a PV system or a shading system; it’s an intelligent skin that uses weather and building data, occupant feedback, and AI algorithms to decide how the facade moves, so buildings stay comfortable, avoid overheating, and use energy as efficiently as possible. Solskin is already running on several buildings across Switzerland, with many more to follow. In this role, you own the software that makes that happen. You write the code that runs Solskin, keep it reliable in the field, and constantly improve it. You will also architect and lead our future sensor-to-data platform. Your focus is where software meets hardware, and the control and AI on top of it. You don't need to be a front-end specialist. What you will do This is a hands-on leadership position: you code every day. Own the full stack: You maintain and develop the whole software stack, from cloud and data management to user-facing applications, and from low-level embedded firmware to high-level AI controllers learning from users. You keep it reliable and keep making it better. Be the link between the teams: You build the software that runs on real buildings and support the hardware team. You also build the internal tools used by sales and the business team. Lead what comes next : With the CEO and CTO, you set the software direction and lead development of future products. Our stack: Backend: Python, FastAPI, PyTorch Frontend: React, TypeScript Hardware: C/C++, STM32 microcontrollers, Beckhoff PLCs Database: PostgreSQL (TimescaleDB) DevOps & Cloud: Linux, Docker, AWS, Grafana What we are looking for Required: Education : MSc or PhD in Computer Science, Robotics, Electrical or Mechanical Engineering, or similar. Python : This is a must. You write clean Python that runs in production,

jobs.company: ECOLE NATIONALE SUPERIEURE DE TECHNIQUES AVANCEES
jobs.description: ENSTA, établissement d’enseignement supérieur et de recherche sous tutelle du ministère des Armées, développe des activités de formation, de recherche et d’innovation dans les domaines de la défense et de la sécurité, des transports, de l'énergie, des activités maritimes, du numérique et de la santé. L’école, présente sur deux campus, à Paris-Saclay et à Brest, est membre de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris. Classée dans le Top 10 des meilleures écoles d’ingénieurs en France, elle a pour mission : la formation d’élèves ingénieurs civils et militaires, de cadres et docteurs pour les secteurs public et privé, la recherche et l’innovation de haut niveau en relation étroite avec l’industrie des grands secteurs de souveraineté au sein de 6 unités de formation et de recherche (UFR). Le/la titulaire du poste sera affecté au sein de l’Unité de Formation et de Recherche (UFR) Mécanique. L’UFR de Mécanique a pour mission d’assurer la formation en mécanique des élèves du cursus ingénieur d’ENSTA, des élèves de masters de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris, et la formation par la recherche d’étudiants français et étrangers au niveau master et doctorat. L’Unité développe également des activités de recherche dans le domaine de la mécanique des matériaux et des structures, de la mécanique des fluides, des vibrations et de l’acoustique. Ces activités sont réalisées grâce à un important parc expérimental de haut niveau en mécanique des solides et des fluides, tant pour l’enseignement que la recherche. Sur le campus de Brest, l’UFR de Mécanique compte une cinquantaine d’enseignants chercheurs, une cinquantaine de doctorants/post-doctorants ainsi qu’une dizaine de personnels techniques (ingénieurs, techniciens). Les activités de recherche des membres de l’UFR de Mécanique du site de Brest sont menées au sein de l’Institut de Recherche Dupuy de Lôme (IRDL, CNRS UMR 6027, www.irdl.fr ). La personne recrutée travaillera en étroite collaboration avec les enseignants-chercheurs de l’ENSTA,

jobs.description: Come join the organization that is redefining security for the AI era. As one of the fastest-growing startups ever, we enable teams to secure cloud and AI applications by connecting code, cloud, and runtime into a single shared context. Trusted by security teams all over the world, we have a proven track record of success and a culture that values world-class talent. Not to mention, we re now powered by Google , meaning we offer our customers an AI-powered platform that harnesses Google’s Threat Intelligence and Security Operations to better detect, prevent, and respond to threats across all environments, allowing for further innovation. Our Wizards from all over the globe work together to protect the infrastructure of our customers, including over 65% of the Fortune 100, who trust us to scan and secure over 230 billion files daily. We’re honored to be a leading player in a massive and growing market, and we continue to look for exceptional Wizards who are eager to make a significant impact on our team. At Wiz, you’ll have the freedom to think creatively, dream big, and use your full range of skills to contribute to our momentous growth. Come join our team and help us create secure cloud environments that allow even the best companies to move faster, all while having some fun! jobs.description: About Alta Ares Alta Ares is an air defense Neoprime. We build AI-guided interceptors to counter drones and cruise missiles, along with the software platform that powers them. Founded in 2024, we have grown to 90 people, raised over $60M, and increased revenue 40× this year. We are now entering a new phase of international expansion, industrial scaling, fundraising, and product development. Role & Mission NATO agencies & EU programs are investing in counter-drone capability now, and Alta Ares answers a fast-growing flow of their tenders and calls for proposals. As Bid & Project Manager in our EU, NATO & Eastern Flank team, you turn each opportunity into a compliant offer, then into a project delivered on time. Your sales director owns the customer relationship and the commercial strategy; you own the offer and its delivery. This is not a one-programme job. You will run several bids and projects at once: a NATO bid, an EU grant proposal, and an RFI can land in the same week, and none of them can slip. This is a demanding, high-ownership role. jobs.description: Volg jij een opleiding in marketing, AI, communicatie, (creative) business of een vergelijkbare studie? Zoek je een afstudeerstage en heb je interesse in een focus op content of growth marketing? We hebben jouw creativiteit en vernieuwende ideeën nodig! Wij zijn namelijk op zoek naar een creatieve student die ons helpt met het maken van marketingcampagnes in woord én beeld. Dit betekent een focus op content creatie en/of growth marketing. Wat ga je doen? Dat bepaal je voornamelijk zelf! Afhankelijk van je opleiding en interesses stellen we een takenpakket samen dat aansluit bij de uitdagingen, doelstellingen en projecten die spelen binnen ons team. Is AI je beste vriend? Mooi, daar kunnen we nog veel in ontwikkelingen. Interesse in de Socials? Fijn, we kunnen je creativiteit goed gebruiken. Vlotte pen? Ook prima! Jouw teksten krijgen bij ons het podium dat ze verdienen. Kortom, afhankelijk van jouw input, ideeën en talenten kijken we samen wat je gaat doen, zoals: Vormgeving; Webinarproducties; Website-optimalisatie en -onderhoud; E-mail marketing; Social media; Deep dive in de analytics; Meedenken in plannen rondom AI. Vanaf dag één nemen we je bij de hand en laten je zien hoe de praktijk werkt. Maar na verloop van tijd kun jij het (bijna) helemaal zelf en vertel je ons hoe het beter kan. Met wie werk je samen? Natuurlijk sta je er niet alleen voor. Wij zijn onlangs gegroeid tot een team van zeven enthousiaste marketeers met ieder een eigen specialisme. jobs.title: Field Engineer (m/w/x)
jobs.description: Rotzinger Transver mit Standorten in Kaiseraugst und Altendorf in der Schweiz ist ein führender Anbieter von Lösungen für Produktflusssteuerung, Pufferung, Verteilung und Fördertechnik für die Lebensmittel-, Süsswaren- und Verpackungsindustrie. Unser Portfolio umfasst eine breite Palette innovativer Systeme, die eine zuverlässige Produkthandhabung, eine stabile Linienleistung sowie eine effiziente Verbindung zwischen Verarbeitungs- und Verpackungsprozessen gewährleisten. Mit modularen, skalierbaren und hygienischen Lösungen unterstützen wir unsere Kunden dabei, Produktverluste zu reduzieren, Stillstandszeiten zu minimieren und die Gesamtanlageneffektivität (OEE) zu steigern. Wir sind bestrebt, unser Angebot und unsere Kompetenzen kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln, um den sich wandelnden Anforderungen unserer Kunden gerecht zu werden. Weitere Informationen über Rotzinger Transver und unser umfassendes Leistungsspektrum finden Sie auf der Website: www.rotzingertransver.com. Rotzinger Transver ist Teil von Coesia, einer weltweit tätigen Unternehmensgruppe für innovative Industrie- und Verpackungslösungen mit Hauptsitz in Bologna. jobs.title: Software Engineer, AI Coding Tasks
jobs.description: We're looking for experienced software engineers to build AI coding tasks from a codebase they know well. US$1,000 per task, and you can do as many tasks as you want. You turn a real change from a repository you know into a task that today's best AI coding models struggle with: hard for the models, but fair for a skilled engineer. Your tasks are used to measure and train AI coding models. Remote, any location. US$1,000 per task that passes review. Minimum of one task a week, about 10 hours a week. How it works Apply. Complete a short screener interview and upload your resume. Propose. Once you're selected, pick a change from a repository you know and submit a short proposal. We approve it or suggest a better candidate. Build. In our platform, set up the repository as it was before the change, then write the brief, the correct solution and the grading checks. Stress-test. Try lazy, incorrect and shortcut solutions and make sure your checks catch them. Model testing. Run your task against leading AI models until strong models often fail but a skilled engineer can clearly solve it. Review. A reviewer checks your task and you revise it. Most tasks take more than one round. Next task. Once your task is accepted, start another. Requirements 2+ years of professional software engineering Code merged into a public open-source repository, ideally one you know well. A private codebase you own may also qualify (not employer or client code) Strong in at least one of Python, TypeScript, Go, Rust, Java or C++ Solid with Docker, Linux, Git and automated testing Regular use of an AI coding tool Experience writing tests, rubrics or evaluation criteria, ideally for AI models You can explain a change clearly and concisely, in your own words At least 10 hours a week, starting now A secure personal or work computer (no public or shared machines) Nice to have Deep expertise in one area, such as databases, compilers, distributed systems, security or infrastructure Experience building agent

Your tasks are used to measure and train AI coding models. Remote, any location. US$1,000 per task that passes review. Minimum of one task a week, about 10 hours a week. How it works Apply. Complete a short screener interview and upload your resume. Propose. Once you're selected, pick a change from a repository you know and submit a short proposal. We approve it or suggest a better candidate. Build. In our platform, set up the repository as it was before the change, then write the brief, the correct solution and the grading checks. Stress-test. Try lazy, incorrect and shortcut solutions and make sure your checks catch them. Model testing. Run your task against leading AI models until strong models often fail but a skilled engineer can clearly solve it. Review. A reviewer checks your task and you revise it. Most tasks take more than one round. Next task. Once your task is accepted, start another. jobs.description: PT Patra Drilling Contractor (PDC) adalah perusahaan yang bergerak pada bidang jasa penunjang dalam industri energi di Indonesia. Anak Perusahaan PT Pertamina Drilling Services Indonesia (Pertamina Drilling) yang merupakan bagian dari Subholding Upstream Pertamina. Lowongan Kerja PT Patra Drilling Contractor (PDC). PDC (selanjutnya disebut sebagai Perseroan) didirikan pada 11 September 1981 sebagai perusahaan nasional pertama yang fokus menyediakan layanan pengeboran lepas pantai di Indonesia sebagai prioritas pertama. Setelah 38 tahun berkontribusi dalam penyediaan energi nasional, Perseroan semakin memantapkan langkahnya menjadi perusahaan jasa penunjang industri energi terdepan yang mengutamakan keseimbangan antara aspek people dan , profit dan planet. Hal tersebut dibuktikan dengan pertumbuhan kinerja Perseroan secara eksponensial yang diiringi dengan penguatan pada aspek sosial dan lingkungan. Langkah nyata yang dilakukan Perseroan yaitu dengan memperkuat tata kelola keberlanjutan terutama di bidang kesehatan, keselamatan, keamanan dan pelestarian lingkungan serta mendorong pemerataan kesejahteraan sosial di masyarakat sekitar proyek. Laporan Keberlanjutan Tahun 2019 dikembangkan dengan tema: Mengutamakan Keberlanjutan sebagai Cara untuk Terus Bertumbuh. Associate Well Intervention Supervisor Kualifikasi: Pendidikan minimal SMA/SMK, diutamakan Sarjana (S1) dari semua jurusan. Memiliki pengalaman sebagai Company Man atau pada posisi yang relevan. Memiliki pengalaman di bidang Workover dan Well Services. Memahami aspek Medium Hazard. Memiliki pengalaman dan kompetensi yang relevan dengan standar APPS PPSDMMigas Cepu. jobs.title: Rekrutmen BRILiaN Banking Associate Program (BBAP) Periode Oktober 2026
jobs.description: PT Bank Rakyat Indonesia (Persero) Tbk adalah salah satu bank milik pemerintah yang terbesar di Indonesia. Bank Rakyat Indonesia (BRI) didirikan di Purwokerto, Jawa Tengah oleh Raden Bei Aria Wirjaatmadja tanggal 16 Desember 1895. Bank BRI memiliki layanan perbankan sampai seluruh penjuru Indonesia dan cukup terkenal oleh masyarakat Indonesia. Berikut ini adalah Rekrutmen Banking Officer Program (BBOP) Terbaru. Berpengalaman lebih dari 120 tahun, Bank BRI senantiasa memberikan kemudahan dan kecepatan dalam merespon berbagai kebutuhan nasabah. Dengan didukung oleh layanan perbankan yang prima, jutaan transaksi nasabah dikelola selama 24 jam sehari 7 hari seminggu melalui fasilitas layanan yang tersebar secara luas di seantero negeri. Dalam menjalankan aktivitas operasional, Bank BRI berpedoman pada visi dan misi yang membantu Perusahaan untuk tetap fokus dalam meraih pencapaian keberhasilan. Visi dan misi ini membantu Bank BRI untuk selalu berupaya mencapai idealisme dengan mengingatkan manajemen serta karyawan bahwa mereka bekerja sama demi tujuan-tujuan yang sama, yang akan menjadi sumbangan dalam keberhasilan jangka panjang Perusahaan. Penyesuaian bentuk hukum menjadi Persero, dinyatakan dalam Akta No. 131, tanggal 31 Juli 1992, dibuat di hadapan Muhani Salim, S.H., yang telah diumumkan dalam Berita Negara Republik Indonesia No. 73 tanggal 11 September 1992 Tambahan No. 1A.
